cards.name: The Wicked Worm Beast
cards.description: A monster worm created by the darkness. It suddenly appears from under the ground to attack its enemies.

cards.name: Griffore
cards.description: This creature's tough hide deflects just about any attack.

cards.name: Torike
cards.description: Not as tough as it looks in terms of defense. This monster's sharp horn gives it an edge when attacking.

cards.name: Wolf
cards.description: A rarely seen wolf with a powerful nose for catching the scent of an enemy.

cards.name: Silver Fang
cards.description: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye but absolutely vicious in battle.

cards.name: Mystic Horseman
cards.description: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme speed.

cards.name: Dark Gray
cards.description: Entirely gray, this beast has rarely been seen by mortal eyes.

cards.name: Sleeping Lion
cards.description: Frequently found sleeping, this monster is very dangerous when awakened.

cards.name: Larvas
cards.description: A fast-moving, bird-like creature that strangles an opposing monster with its long, thin arms.

cards.name: Dig Beak
cards.description: Coiling its serpent-like body, this creature spins and attacks with its snapping beak.

cards.name: Lisark
cards.description: An unusual creature with sapphire eyes that creates visions to confuse the enemy.

cards.name: Gate Deeg
cards.description: A creature with an abdominal portal used for summoning monsters from the netherworld.

cards.name: Synchar
cards.description: An ugly creature with two heads and a mouth for blasting laser beams.

cards.name: Fusionist
cards.description: A monstrous cat with wings and a long striking tail.

cards.name: Frenzied Panda
cards.description: A savage beast that carries a big bamboo stick for beating down its enemies.

cards.name: Air Marmot of Nefariousness
cards.description: A horned beaver with wings that throw high-velocity acorns from the sky with uncanny accuracy.

cards.name: Meotoko
cards.description: A huge monster with a single eye that fires an intense beam.

cards.name: Master & Expert
cards.description: A fearsome duo consisting of a beast master and its loyal servant.

cards.name: Nekogal #1
cards.description: A cat creature that looks cute but delivers scratching blows with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Prevent Rat
cards.description: This monster is shielded by a hide covered in thick hair.

cards.name: Mystical Sheep #2
cards.description: A monstrous sheep with a long tail for hypnotizing enemies to render them powerless.

cards.name: Super War-lion
cards.description: A very vicious lion with sharp and long claws.

cards.name: Dark Rabbit
cards.description: A cartoon rabbit that quickly leaps all over the place, making it a difficult target.

cards.name: Leogun
cards.description: Huge monster with a lion's main similar to the "King of Beasts".

cards.name: Tatsunootoshigo
cards.description: A fast-moving sea monster that has the body of a horse and of a fish.

cards.name: Burglar
cards.description: A clever mouse with a sharpened left claw.

cards.name: Garvas
cards.description: A malevolent creature that resembles a winged lion.

cards.name: Flower Wolf
cards.description: A beast covered in flowers from head to toe.

cards.name: Wilmee
cards.description: A ferocious rabbit with sharp claws.

cards.name: Milus Radiant
cards.description: Often mistaken as a cute pet, this creature is a very dangerous beast.

cards.name: Togex
cards.description: A very fast monster that rolls up and rams its enemies.

cards.name: Hane-Hane
cards.description: This creature blocks enemy movement with gale-force winds and attacks with a massive battle axe.

cards.name: Ancient One of the Deep Forest
cards.description: A white goat that has inhabited the forest for ages. The creature is actually an elder of the woods.

cards.name: Mon Larvas
cards.description: A highly evolved Larvas that is even more powerful than before.

cards.name: Pale Beast
cards.description: With skin tinged a bluish white, this strange creature is a fearsome sight to behold.

cards.name: Little Chimera
cards.description: A monster created an experimental attempt to graft wings on beasts.

cards.name: Obese Marmot of Nefariousness
cards.description: An ill-mannered field mouse that chews on anything.

cards.name: Great Bill
cards.description: A monster with a massive maw that allows it to swallow an enemy whole.

cards.name: Armored Rat
cards.description: A rat that is protected by armor-like fur.

cards.name: Mystical Sheep #1
cards.description: A black-haired sheep that is capable of sorcery.

cards.name: Firewing Pegasus
cards.description: A heavenly stallion that flies across the skies on scarlet wings.
